visual_blocks.content: Ton collects cookies for an activity at the classroom. One box has 35 items, and paper plates has 21 more items. How many items does Ton have in all?

visual_blocks.title: Think Story
visual_blocks.content: The story has two groups: 35 and 21. To find the total, add them: 35 + 21 = 56 items.
